Book Excerpt

Page 113

Here are your steps for diagramming a conditional relationship:

1. See a conditional indicator.

2. Draw a Must Arrow.

3. Place an abbreviation of the word or phrase targeted by the conditional indicator on the correct side of the Must Arrow. - Sufficient is on the left, before the Must Arrow. - Necessary is on the right, after the Must Arrow.

4. Fill in the other side of the Must Arrow with whatever is left over in the statement.
